caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular, upright object with a rounded top, resembling a clock or watch case. The front and one visible side are predominantly yellow-green with swirling, leafy patterns, and outlined in red. The front face features a large circular opening in the center and an arched panel above it, decorated with a radial pattern in red, yellow, and green. The border along the top is red. Pencil measurements and notes are sketched around the colored object, and handwritten text in black ink appears at the upper left corner, reading “THOMAS WATTS color sketch submitted for approval.” In the lower right corner, in pencil, are the words "Watch Case #6525" along with additional dimensional measurements in pencil around the object. The background is plain, off-white paper.
title: Watch Case
